Acme Distribution: Operations Manager
Location: Joliet, IL (onsite 4 days a week, 1 remote day)
Salary range: $95,000 to $115,000 base plus annual bonus

About Acme Distribution
Acme Distribution is a regional third-party logistics (3PL) provider running three distribution centers in Illinois and Indiana for consumer goods and food-grade clients. We move about 25,000 orders a week.

About the role
The Operations Manager runs day-to-day operations for our Joliet distribution center, leading a team of 3 shift supervisors and about 45 warehouse associates. You will own productivity, safety, accuracy, and cost for the building, and work with our client success team on service levels.

What you will do
- Lead, coach, and develop 3 shift supervisors and, through them, about 45 associates: hiring, scheduling, performance reviews, and corrective action
- Own building KPIs: units per hour, order accuracy, on-time shipping, dock-to-stock time, and labor cost per unit
- Plan labor against forecast volume each week
- Manage inbound and outbound dock scheduling with carriers
- Use our WMS (Manhattan) and SQL reporting to find and fix bottlenecks
- Lead continuous improvement projects using Lean methods
- Partner with client success on client service level reviews

Required
- 5+ years of experience in warehouse, distribution, or transportation operations
- 3+ years of direct people management, including supervising frontline leads or supervisors
- Hands-on experience with a warehouse management system (WMS), Manhattan preferred
- Working SQL and advanced Excel skills
- Experience owning operational KPIs and reporting on them to leadership

Preferred
- Lean or Six Sigma certification
- APICS certification
- 3PL experience with multiple clients
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI

Schedule: day shift, Monday to Friday, with some Saturdays during peak season.
